model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines on the plot, each representing a different condition. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," starts at a sparsity ratio of 0.03 and remains relatively flat across the layers. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," begins at a sparsity ratio of 0.44 and shows a general decline as the layers increase, with some fluctuations. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at a sparsity ratio of 0.33 and follows a similar declining trend to the orange line, with more pronounced fluctuations. The plot does not provide any additional context or data points beyond the average values and the general trends of the sparsity ratios.
